N1.s: %lld 个免费剪切片段已存满。到“剪切片段”里继续，解锁后就会帮你存下这一个。
N1.back: 5 (mw) free cut-clip-pieces already saved-full. go-to 'Cut-clip-pieces' inside continue, unlock after then will help you save-down this one (mw).
N1.why: Opens with the same 已存满 as K1 and S3; 到…里继续 picks up the system's continue choice, and 帮你存下这一个 promises this item without a second 剪切片段, so Siri can say it in one breath.

N2.s: %lld 个免费剪切片段已存满。打开“剪切片段”解锁，就能接着存。
N2.back: 5 (mw) free cut-clip-pieces already saved-full. open 'Cut-clip-pieces' unlock, then can keep-on save.
N2.why: Same first sentence as N1 so both Shortcut replies sound alike; 接着存 is the spoken 'keep saving', and it does not promise this item is held, because here it is not.

N3.s: 已保存，还能免费再存一个
N3.back: already saved, still can free again save one (mw)
N3.why: 还能…再存一个 says one place is left as a person would say it; 一个 in characters because a lone 'one' in running Chinese is written that way; 11 CJK, no period in a capsule.

N4.s: 已保存，免费 %lld/%lld 已存满
N4.why: Compact pair in the S29 style with 存满 from K1; numbers run in the same order as the M4 pair, so no positional forms; 8 CJK plus the pair.

N5.s: 免费 %lld/%lld 已存满，轻点解锁就能存下这个
N5.back: free 5/5 already saved-full, tap unlock then can save-down this (mw)
N5.why: Continues N4's 免费 5/5 已存满 so the keyboard's three messages read as one voice; 轻点 is Apple zh-Hans for tap, as in K1; 存下这个 tells them the item they are saving is not lost; 15 CJK plus the pair.

N6.why: The bare verb, as zh-Hans buttons in the save slot are one verb (保存, 完成); same 解锁 as S14 and M1; 2 CJK.

N7.s: %lld 个免费剪切片段已存满。解锁“剪切片段”后，就会帮你存下这一个。
N7.back: 5 (mw) free cut-clip-pieces already saved-full. unlock 'Cut-clip-pieces' after, then will help you save-down this one (mw).
N7.why: Same promise in the same words as N1, so the Share sheet and Siri agree; the app name in “” keeps it apart from the item word, as in S19; 26 CJK, two lines.

N8.s: 这个剪切片段已帮你先留着。打开“剪切片段”解锁，它就会存好。
N8.back: this (mw) cut-clip-piece already for-you first kept. open 'Cut-clip-pieces' unlock, it then will saved-done.
N8.why: 先留着 says 'held for now' and so carries the reassurance first; 它就会存好 closes on the item, not the purchase; 25 CJK.
